chapter.verse: Tua ciangin adang a thahat vantungmi khat in vantung meii silhin vantung pan hong kumsuk ka mu hi. Ama lutang tungah sakhituihup a om hi, a maitang ni bang ahi hi, a khete meikuang bang ahi hi.
A khut sungah laibu neu khat phenin a tawi hi. A taklam a khe tui tungah ahi zongin, a veilam khe leitungah ahi zongin a ngak khit ciangin,
humpinelkai a hawk bangin nakpi aw tawh kiko a, a kiko ciangin vanging sagihte in amau kam awte a gen uh hi.
Tua bangin vanging sagihte genna gelh dingin ka kisak leh, “Vanging sagihte in a gen uh thute ciamtehin gelh kei in,” ci-in vantung pan hong pusuak aw ka za hi.
Tua lai takin tuitung leh leitungah ding-in a om ka muh vantungmi in a khut taklam vantung lamah lamto a,

“Sagihna vantumgmi in peengkul tum ding a kisak a, aw a gin’ hun lai takin Pasian’ sila pawl kamsangte tungah a gensa tawh kituakin, Pasian’ thu thukpi in zekai loin a zo khin ding hi,” ci-in a tawntungin nungta-in, vantung leh vantung sungah a omte, leitung leh leitung sungah a omte, tuipi leh tuipi sungah a omte a piangsak Topa tawh a kiciam hi.
Tua lai takin ka zak ngeisa vantungmi’ aw in khat vei kei kiangah, “Tuipi tung leh lei tungah ding-in a om vantungmi khut sungah kiphenin a om laibu pai in la, va la in,” hong ci hi.
Tua vantungmi kiangah pai-in tua laibu neu ka va nget ciangin vantungmi in, “La in la, ne in. Na gil sungah a kha ding hi, na kam sungah ahih leh, khuaizu bangin a khum ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua bangin kei in vantungmi khut sung pan laibu neu la-in ka nek leh, ka kam sungah khuaizu bangin a khum hi, ka nek khit ciangin ka gil sungah a kha hi.
Tua lai takin, “Nangmah in mipawlte, gamte, kamte, kumpi tampite thu tawh kizomin a nungcianga piang ding thu na genkhol ding hi,” ci-in hong gen uh hi.
